Dialogs.Dialog: All right, ready when you are？
Want to take a whole bunch？
You're gonna take a lot？ Hmm？
I'm not really used to this...
Jeez, I guess I have no choice.
Isn't that enough？ Let's do the rest next time.
I'm glad I got to take so many.
Okay, that's it for now. That was quite a lot, right？
Yeah. I got plenty of shots, so let's stop here.
I got carried away. Maybe I took too many.
I wouldn't have minded taking more, though.
Huh, you're done taking pictures already？
I got quite a few, so I'm satisfied. Thanks.
That's plenty, right？ We're done for today.
Guess I'll leave it at that.
Got it. I don't want you getting tired, ▲小早川＊▲.
Hey, I'm starting to get tired.
Sorry, sorry. Let's call it a day.
Did you get some good pictures？
I think so. Look forward to seeing them.
Hehe, and right when I was getting into it.
My bad... Wore you out, huh.
Rinko... might be at her limit.
I ended up taking quite a lot before I knew it.
Looks like you got some good ones.
Yeah, especially with how many I took.
That actually got my heart racing a bit.
I think I got a little too into it myself.
Aren't you taking a bit too many？
Come on, don't just take pictures the whole time...
Hey, pictures are fine and all, but... listen to me too.
Sorry, I was just having too much fun.
Look, doing nothing but taking pictures is a bit much.
Hey... let's call it quits on the photos. There are other fun things we can do.
Make sure I look good, okay？
Make me look cute, okay？ Hehe.
Make sure you get my best angle.
You can't complain about your model, right？
I'm kind of curious how they'll turn out.
Make sure you save the photos, okay？ Believe it or not, I'm looking forward to seeing them.
I always look forward to seeing how the photos turn out.
I wonder how they'll turn out？
Let's capture lots of memories of us together.
Even this moment's gonna become a memory, huh.
Let's keep taking lots more pictures from now on.
I wonder if this photo's gonna feel nostalgic before we know it？
No way! Don't push your luck.
As if I'd let you take a shot like that.
Make it look as nice as you can, okay？
If I don't look cute in it, I'm not looking at it.
It's always exciting looking at the finished photos.
Believe it or not, I'm actually looking forward to this.
It's fun looking through the finished photos together.
I wonder how the photos will turn out...
We're making more memories little by little, huh.
All of these are memories too, so we've gotta treasure them.
I wonder how many memories we'll end up making？
I want to make lots more memories like this.
Honestly, talk about getting carried away.
Obviously I'm not letting you do that.
My face is going to be red in all of these...
I just can't relax like this.
Quit staring at me like that.
Don't ask me to do anything too complicated.
Even if it looks weird, don't laugh.
I was definitely making a weird face just now...
Feels like I'll get some great shots.
Looks like ▲小早川＊▲'s getting into it too.
Oh, this angle might be good.
That was a great expression just now.
I need to get more creative with my shots.
I'm definitely going to get a great shot.
I want to bring out a more natural expression.
Maybe we're both getting used to the camera.
I want to capture the real ▲小早川＊▲.
An expression you don't usually see might be nice.
I can't be the one getting nervous here...
I wonder if I can get a good shot...
I'd better not make things hard on ▲小早川＊▲...
I need to get better at this soon...
I wonder if this is okay？
It's tough to get the hang of this.
The model is great, at least...
Anyway, let's just keep taking pictures.
Seeing you get all serious... It's kinda funny.
It makes me... a little shy.
Hey... What was with that wind just now？
Ah... Come on, you've gotta be kidding me.
You don't have to stare like that.
What are you gawking at？ You're such an idiot...
Do that again and you'll get worse than a kick.
Seriously... Is that all you ever think about？
Honestly... If you're gonna look, don't be sneaky about it...
Are you into... weird stuff or something？
That doesn't really make me feel great...
What are you even trying to shoot？
What if I say... no？ Hehe.
Huh!? Why'd you have to startle me like that...
Eek... Don't scare me like that, seriously.
Ah... Hey, why is there a draft？ Is something open？
I'll get mad if you took that, okay？ I'm definitely checking later.
What are you shooting？ You know that's off-limits.
If you're gonna take shots like that, I'm quitting, okay？
Geez... What are you even taking a picture of.
Do you want that kind of shot so badly？
What are you even talking about.
